{{Top|leg}}
The '''system fortification''' module carefully monitored and regulated the circuitry of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Thus, the droid's functions were not disturbed by minor electrical spikes and fluctuations. A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
